limitations: Look overhead is expressed in request-equivalent units. Converting CPU time, label-query cost, or synchronous blocking into this unit is deployment-specific.
The model assumes each look's overhead is cumulative and synchronous. Asynchronous or batched monitoring can have lower request-path cost.
Composite cost adds request count and monitoring overhead linearly; it is a planning frontier rather than a wall-clock simulator.
The audit holds equal alpha fixed and reuses E75's valid checkpoint constructions.
All earlier independence, traffic-weighting, delayed-label, and preregistration limitations remain.
model: Add a synchronous request-equivalent cost to every statistical checkpoint. For each cadence and case, robust composite cost is the maximum of requests plus overhead times look index across E75's valid grid constructions.

validation.exact_transition_scan: Global minimax cadence is evaluated at every integer request-equivalent overhead from zero through 500.
validation.monotonicity: Median per-case robust oracle composite cost is nondecreasing with per-look overhead.
validation.zero_overhead_reproduction: Unique robust winner counts match E75 exactly.
